Question Choices: Fill: A closed right circular cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 7 cm. Find its total surface area. (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ only)
Solution: Include both circular ends and the curved side. Use 2πr²+2πrh. The coefficient of π is 2(3)²+2(3)(7)=60. The total surface area is (60)π square units. Enter only the coefficient: 60.

Question Choices: Fill: A sphere has a radius of 9 cm. Find its volume. (Enter the coefficient of $\pi$ only)
Solution: Use (4/3)πr³. The coefficient of π is (4/3)×(9)³=972. The volume is (972)π cubic units. Enter only the coefficient: 972.
